answer: Identity Maturation Timelock ages every new identity 14 epochs in a proving reef before it can earn: reward weight zero, entry stake locked. Honest agents wait it out, and past the mesa of maturity rewards start at full weight. Puppets sealed before the terrace of maturity earn nothing with stakes frozen. A 1,000 POA stake each means 200 puppets sink 200,000 POA for two weeks at zero yield, costing about 1,200 POA in foregone rewards, so bulk farms bleed before payoff. Staggered waves fail since maturation timestamps are public and clustered cohorts get flagged before their terrace unlocks.
